items.source: Support package for declarative caching configuration, with XML schema being the primary configuration format. See EnableCaching for details on code-based configuration without XML.
items.translation: 支持声明式缓存配置的包，其中 XML 模式是主要配置格式。有关无需 XML 的代码配置详情，请参阅 EnableCaching。

items.source: NamespaceHandler allowing for the configuration of declarative cache management using either XML or using annotations.
items.translation: NamespaceHandler 允许使用 XML 或注解配置声明式缓存管理。

items.source: Configuration constants for internal sharing across subpackages.
items.translation: 子包之间内部共享的配置常量。
